description: OpsAgent read-only Microsoft Configuration Manager inventory collection.

runCommand: if (-not (Test-Path $module)) { throw 'Configuration Manager PowerShell module is not installed.' }
if (-not $site) { throw 'No Configuration Manager CMSite PowerShell drive is available.' }

$payload = [ordered]@{ collected_at=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); site_code=$site.Name; provider=$site.Root; summary=[ordered]@{ devices=$devices.Count; active_clients=@($devices | Where-Object { $_.ClientActiveStatus -eq 1 -or $_.IsActive }).Count; collections=$collections.Count; deployments=$deployments.Count; update_groups=$updateGroups.Count }; devices=$devices; collections=$collections; deployments=$deployments; update_groups=$updateGroups }
